newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo's IMT plans 25,000 tractors by 2000 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Yugo's IMT plans 25,000 tractors by 2000 - paper.

text.p: Yugoslavia's engine and tractor factory Industrija Motora i Traktora (IMT) plans to produce around 25,000 tractors by the year 2000, Belgrade newspaper Vecernje Novosti reported on Monday.
Under its current development plan, IMT will also produce some 25,000 other units in the same period, the paper said.
IMT expects to produce some 5,000 tractors and 5,000 engines in 1997, according to the report.
By the end of May, the factory plans to begin manufacturing heavy 135-hp tractors IMT-5136 earmarked for buyers in China.
IMT plans to manufacture 50 heavy tractors per month over the next two years, which will ensure full-time work for 600 of its employees and reduce the number of workers currently on "waiting lists".
IMT's pre-sanctions annual capacity stood at some 40,000 small and medium-sized tractors, but last year it barely produced 1,600 units. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
